effects_provenance.raw: Caked Up Candy · Greenhouse THCa Flower 14g Caked Up Candy THCa (Runtz × Caked Up Cherries) is an indica-leaning hybrid grown in the greenhouse with organic inputs. Dense, frosty buds carry the sweet candy character of Runtz with a creamy cherry edge. The nose is packed with cherry candy, sweet berries, and vanilla. The smoke follows with sugary fruit and creamy cherry, finishing with a lingering candy sweetness. Effects are happy and relaxed, starting with an easygoing head change before settling into a mellow body feel. A flavorful afternoon or evening smoke for fans of sweet Runtz and dessert strains.
